_notes: What the live provider overrides, and with which public quote. Symbols are Yahoo Finance front-month futures (delayed, no API key). 'scale' and 'offset' convert the quote to the unit and grade of the reference data: value = quote x scale + offset. 'min' / 'max' are plausibility bounds on the converted value: a quote outside them is discarded and the static figure is used. Everything not listed here (freight, port fees, TC/RC, bauxite, destination differentials) has no free public quote and stays static.
_sofr_basis: SOFR level the static financing rates were set against (early Nov 2026). Live financing rate = static rate + (live SOFR - this reference), i.e. live SOFR plus the same credit margin.

Cu.label: COMEX copper, front month, converted from USD/lb

crude_oil.label: ICE Brent, front month, as a proxy for the medium-sour delivered benchmark

iron_ore.label: SGX 62 % Fe CFR China, front month, plus an indicative USD 13 premium for 65 % Fe
